tasks.description: Add a 'Forgot password?' link on the login page that opens a form for users to request a password reset. This form should collect the user's account email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address is displayed.

tasks.description: Develop a function to generate single-use, time-limited reset tokens. These tokens should be unique and expire after a specified time window.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when a token is generated, then the token is unique and has a limited lifetime.

tasks.description: Implement a feature to email a reset link containing the generated token to the user's registered email address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the reset token is generated, then an email with a reset link is sent to the user's registered email address.

tasks.description: Develop a form where users can enter and confirm a new password. This form should be reachable from the emailed reset link and validate the reset token before accepting the new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user follows the reset link, when they enter and confirm a new password, then the password is updated if the token is valid and not expired.

tasks.description: Ensure the new password is hashed and stored using the existing password-hashing scheme.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the new password is stored, then it is hashed using the existing password-hashing scheme.

tasks.description: After a successful password reset, invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when they attempt to use an existing session token, then the session is invalid and access is denied.

tasks.description: Ensure the system correctly rejects expired, already-used, or invalid tokens to maintain security.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid or expired token, when a user attempts to reset their password, then the reset is rejected and an appropriate error message is displayed.
